channel.title: The Batch | DeepLearning.AI
channel.description: Weekly AI news for engineers, executives, and enthusiasts.

item.title: How Liquids and Gases Behave: A dynamic fluids model appears to solve transformers’ pixellation problem
item.description: Simulating complex physical systems through traditional numerical methods is slow and expensive, and simulations based on machine learning are usually specialized for a specific type of system, such as water in a pipe or atmosphere surrounding a planet.

item.title: Dark DNA Unveiled: Google’s AlphaGenome interprets DNA that regulates genetic expression
item.description: An open-weights model could help scientists compare the impact of genetic variations, identify mutations that cause diseases, and develop treatments.

item.title: Pitfalls in Assistive Models for the Blind: Blind people can use AI models as virtual mirrors, but don’t always like what they see
item.description: People whose vision is impaired increasingly use AI to assess their own appearance, raising questions about the psychological impact of AI models that are trained on conventional standards of beauty.

item.title: Claude Mythos Preview Raises Security Worries: Why Claude’s advanced Mythos Preview model will be limited-release-only
item.description: Anthropic took unusual steps to prepare the world for a forthcoming large language model that it said poses extraordinary risks to cybersecurity.

item.title: Anthropic’s Claude Mythos Problem, Dark DNA Unveiled, Pitfalls for Assistive Models, Simulating Fluid Dynamics
item.description: The Batch AI News and Insights: As AI agents accelerate coding, what is the future of software engineering?

item.title: Building Voice-Enabled Apps is Easier Than You May Think: Voice-enabled AI applications are improving quickly. Get ready for the next wave of AI!
item.description: Voice-based AI that you can talk to is improving rapidly, yet most people still don’t appreciate how pervasive voice UIs (user interfaces) will become.

item.title: China’s showdown with NeurIPS conference: Claude’s emotion vectors aren’t feelings, but affect behavior
item.description: Google’s updates to its open model family. Cursor 3, a brand-new interface built for agents. Microsoft AI’s latest speech and image models. Anthropic’s clampdown on OpenClaw.

item.title: Learning Long Context at Inference: Test-Time Training End-to-End (TTT-E2E) retrains model weights to handle long inputs
item.description: Large language models typically become less accurate and slower when they process longer contexts, but researchers enabled an LLM to keep accuracy stable and inference time constant as its context grew.

item.title: Gemini’s Music Generator: Google debuted Lyria 3, an app that turns text or images into 30-second songs
item.description: Google added a music generator to Gemini and YouTube, putting a model that produces synthetic songs in front of hundreds of millions of users.

item.title: OpenAI Exits Video Generation: OpenAI will shut down Sora, its once state-of-the-art video model
item.description: OpenAI plans to shut down its video generator Sora in a sudden retreat from the video market.

item.title: Inside Claude Code: Claude Code’s source code leaked, exposing potential future features Kairos and autoDream
item.description: The inner workings of the popular coding agent Claude Code are available for all to see.

item.title: How Anti-AI Propaganda Hurts the Public: The anti-AI coalition is beoming more sophisticated in its efforts to block progress
item.description: The anti-AI coalition continues to maneuver to find arguments to slow down AI progress.

item.title: Context As An External Variable: Recursive Language Models offer path to aramatically expand beyond the context window
item.description: When processing long contexts, large language models often lose track of details or devolve into nonsense. Researchers reduced these effects by managing context externally.

item.title: xAI’s Cost-Effective Video Generator: Grok Imagine 1.0 sharply cuts costs for high-quality video generation
item.description: xAI launched a video generator that topped an independent quality ranking at a fraction of competitors’ prices.
